apps.name: Sample Size
apps.subtitle: References and decisions for your clothing brand.
apps.localizedDescription: Image-first clothing-brand research and review. Multi-photo galleries, five built-in catalogs, custom source controls, separate taste lanes, named collections, fractional ratings, exact-image notes, graphic criteria, revision comparison and multi-file references/casting. Recoverable drafts and complete attachment backups. Tag-based ranking; no visual AI training, live site sync or background push. Grailed/Depop are links/manual imports, not connected accounts. Unsigned for Feather signing. Requires iOS16.4 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: Image-first navigation, photo galleries and zoom, five verified public catalogs, add/pause sources, named collections, exact-image Keep/Change notes, graphic scoring, revision comparison, recovered drafts and complete file backups. 34 app tests, mobile browser checks and unsigned arm64 IPA verification passed. Native iPhone runtime untested. Live site/Dot sync, marketplace integrations and visual-model learning remain pending.
